title: Hide Administrator role until a specific phone number is entered

requirements.text: In the profile setup dialog, hide the "Administrator" role option by default and only reveal it when the user enters the phone number (91)980115950 in the "Phone Number" input (matching by digits, ignoring formatting characters).

quotes: faça com que a opção administrador fique oculta e só apareça quando for inserido o numero (91)980115950 na área Número de telefone

acceptanceCriteria: When the phone number input is empty or does not normalize to 91980115950, the Administrator radio option is not rendered/visible in the role selection list.
When the phone number input normalizes to 91980115950 (e.g., entered as "(91)980115950" or "91980115950"), the Administrator option becomes visible without requiring a page refresh.
Phone matching is performed using digits-only comparison (ignore parentheses and any non-digits).

requirements.text: Ensure the "Phone Number" input is available to the user at the time they choose a role (so they can unlock the Administrator option), and prevent inconsistent state when the Administrator option becomes hidden again.
acceptanceCriteria: The user can access the phone number input without first needing to select a specific role, so they can unlock the Administrator option.

If the user has selected the Administrator role and then edits the phone number so it no longer matches 91980115950, the UI automatically deselects Administrator (switch to a non-admin role) and hides the Administrator option again.
No backend calls to admin verification/allowlisting are possible unless the Administrator role is visible and selected.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (shadcn components) or any other paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Do not change the backend admin password/allowlist logic.
Do not add new authentication providers or change the Internet Identity flow.
